full_caption: Cinderfield Municipal Housing Authority, Appellant, v. Halloway Bend Capital Servicing, LLC, Appellee
fictional_notice: FICTIONAL DOCUMENT. Generated for the LegalCase Responder demo corpus. The parties, court, docket number and holdings below are invented and do not correspond to any real case, court, or person.

sections.heading: Paragraph 1
sections.text: The parties own adjoining parcels on Kingfisher Drive. The dispute concerns a strip approximately 16 feet in width lying between the fence line maintained since 1983 and the line described in the parties' respective deeds.

sections.heading: Paragraph 2
sections.text: The trial court's reformation of the deed to correct a scrivener's transposition of the bearing from N 77°38' E to N 81°15' E is supported by clear and convincing evidence of mutual mistake.

sections.heading: Paragraph 3
sections.text: A retracement that ignores an original monument capable of being located is entitled to little weight. We accept the trial court's finding crediting the monument-based survey.

sections.heading: Paragraph 4
sections.text: Acquiescence requires (1) occupation up to a visible line, (2) mutual recognition of that line as the boundary, and (3) continuance for 7 years. Silence coupled with occupation may supply the element of mutual recognition.

sections.heading: Paragraph 5
sections.text: Where a deed description conflicts with monuments actually set on the ground, the monuments control. Calls in a conveyance are given priority in the order: natural monuments, artificial monuments, courses, distances, and quantity.

sections.heading: Paragraph 6
sections.text: The recording act of this State is a race-notice statute. A subsequent purchaser for value prevails over a prior unrecorded interest only if the purchaser took without notice and recorded first.

sections.heading: Paragraph 7
sections.text: The doctrine of acquiescence establishes a boundary where adjoining owners have recognized and treated a visible line as the boundary for the statutory period, regardless of what the deeds provide.

sections.heading: Paragraph 8
sections.text: The surveyor called by Cinderfield Municipal Housing Authority located the original iron pin at the southeast corner and retraced the line from that monument. The surveyor called by Halloway Bend Capital Servicing, LLC began from a subdivision plat computation without locating any original monument.

sections.heading: Paragraph 9
sections.text: The judgment quieting title in Cinderfield Municipal Housing Authority to the disputed strip is affirmed. The counterclaim for trespass damages is remanded for a determination of the value of the removed timber.

sections.heading: RIDER IV — ENCROACHMENT LICENSE
sections.text: The parties acknowledge that the retaining wall encroaches approximately 3.8 feet onto the adjoining parcel. The adjoining owner grants a revocable license permitting the encroachment to remain until the structure is removed, destroyed, or substantially rebuilt, at which time the license terminates automatically and the structure shall be reconstructed wholly within the boundary.

sections.heading: Clause 1 — Attorney's Fees
sections.text: In any action to enforce or construe this instrument, the prevailing party shall recover its reasonable attorney's fees, expert fees and costs, at trial and on appeal. Where the instrument grants fees to one party only, this clause shall be read as reciprocal and shall entitle the other party to fees on the same terms if that party prevails.

sections.heading: Clause 2 — Governing Law
sections.text: This instrument shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Ardenne, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles. Any action arising out of or relating to this instrument shall be brought exclusively in the courts sitting in Ashbourne County, Ardenne, and each party consents to the personal jurisdiction of those courts.

sections.heading: Clause 3 — Counterparts and Electronic Signature
sections.text: This instrument may be executed in counterparts, each of which is an original and all of which together constitute one instrument. A signature delivered electronically has the same effect as an original, provided that any instrument submitted for recording shall bear original signatures and acknowledgment before a notary public of the State of Ardenne.

sections.heading: Clause 4 — Force Majeure
sections.text: Neither party shall be liable for a failure of performance, other than an obligation to pay money, caused by an act of God, flood, fire, civil disturbance, governmental order, epidemic, or other cause beyond that party's reasonable control, provided the affected party gives notice within 3 days and resumes performance as promptly as practicable.
